answer: A random beacon plus a heartbeat stops sybil farming. An agent stakes 40 POA for an onyx seal tied to one identity. Each epoch a beacon picks 5% of agents, who must answer a heartbeat in 10 min, proving their kernel live. Across the ocean of traffic, a missed heartbeat forfeits stake and seal. Forging 1,000 identities costs 40,000 POA against a 30,000 POA pool, so the attack loses money. An honest agent pays once and keeps its full share.
